Oracle Integration

Integrate with Oracle ERP for timesheet and financial data.

oracle_timesheets

Oracle timesheet and ERP export API router.

This module provides the REST API endpoints for the timesheet pre-population engine and Oracle ERP export staging service. It bridges the Eisenhower Portfolio Manager’s internal scheduling system with Oracle EBS cost accounting.

Endpoints Overview

The router is mounted at /api/v1/timesheets/oracle and provides:

  • GET /prepopulate — Pre-populate a user’s weekly timesheet from active CPM assignments. Returns scheduled hours for each working day so the user can confirm or adjust rather than entering from scratch.

  • POST /batches/create — Close an approved weekly period and generate an export batch. This creates a TimesheetOracleExportBatch record and prepares the staging payload.

  • GET /batches/{id}/download — Stream the formatted Oracle staging payload (CSV) for a given batch. Classified task names are automatically replaced with sanitised cost-code identifiers.

  • GET /batches/{id} — Get the details of an export batch including status, period, and record count.

Authentication

All endpoints require a valid JWT token. The authenticated user’s identity is used to determine which timesheet data to return and to record audit trail entries.

Data Sanitization

When generating Oracle staging payloads, classified task names (SECRET or higher) are automatically replaced with their Oracle cost-code identifiers. This prevents classified information from leaking into the ERP system.

For example, a task named “CLASSIFIED AVIONICS INTEGRATION” with Oracle task number “10.02.01” will appear in the export as “Task 10.02.01”.

Dependencies

These endpoints require a live PostgreSQL instance to query ResourceAssignments, PortfolioNodes, and OracleProjectMappings.

What You Can Do

Viewing Information

  • View: Pre-populate the authenticated user’s weekly timesheet from active CPM assignments.

  • View: Download the Oracle EBS staging payload for a given export batch.

  • View: Get the details of an Oracle export batch.

Creating New Items

  • Create: Close an approved weekly period and generate an Oracle export batch.
